title: Tensor closure for a fixed Galois partition
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$, let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a scheme [def-pc-scheme] admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]), and let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian $\Lambda$-algebra. Work with sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant ring sheaf $A_X$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Fix a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] of $X$ by connected reduced subschemes $S_i$, and for each $i$ a connected finite etale surjection $V_i\to S_i$ with a finite group acting simply transitively on every geometric fibre; call this data $\mathcal P$. Let $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$ consist of those module sheaves $E$ whose inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] to each $S_i$ is a filtered colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of sheaves admitting finite filtrations by subsheaves, with successive quotients locally constant $A_{S_i}$-module sheaves whose inverse images to $V_i$ are constant. Here locally constant means isomorphic to a constant module sheaf after an etale covering, and neither the constant values nor the sheaves in the filtrations are required to be finitely generated. For all $E,G\in\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$, the ordinary sheaf tensor product $E\otimes_{A_X}G$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] belongs to $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$. No flatness assumption is imposed on either factor; this assertion concerns ordinary tensor product.

source.place: Expose XVII, 7.2.3-7.2.5 and Definitions 7.3.2-7.3.3, pp. 301-304; Proposition 11.3.4 and Proposition 11.2.1(i),(vii),(x),(xi), pp. 328-330. Tensor-filtration consequence of the discrete local-system/ind-unipotent description, used in Lemma 7.6.11.
